name: AutoRole
short: Silently grant selected roles to each new human member.
description: Per-server automatic join roles. Manage with [p]autorole add, remove, list, on, off, and clear. Honors Discord Membership Screening, checks role hierarchy, and refuses staff-permission roles.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores only server-specific automatic role IDs and enabled status. Does not store any personal information, member IDs, or join records.
install_msg: AutoRole installed! Run [p]load autorole, then [p]autorole add @Member. Ensure Fatboy has Manage Roles, Server Members Intent, and a higher role than the role to assign.
